name: Lüdinghausen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Lüdinghausen (a red bell and a rose on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Lüdinghausen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Lüdinghausen arms — bell and rose on yellow
